identity.title: A 50 pc Scale View of Star Formation Efficiency across NGC 628

question.value: How does molecular gas depletion time vary with spatial scale (50-500 pc) in NGC 628, and what does GMC/HII region overlap imply about the star formation cycle?

evidence.quote: We catalog and match individual GMCs and H II regions to characterize the overlap phase in the star formation sequence.
